sents.zh: 北京有一个很大很老的房子。
sents.en: In Beijing there is a very large and very old set of buildings.
People call it the Forbidden City.

sents.zh: 它是明朝的王让人做的。
sents.en: It was built for a Ming ruler.
Inside there are more than nine thousand rooms.
The buildings are red and very beautiful.

sents.zh: 王在最大的那个房间里做事。
sents.en: The ruler worked in the largest room.

sents.zh: 很多官每天早上来见他。
sents.en: Many officials came to see him every morning.

sents.zh: 里面还有很多好看的东西。
sents.en: There are many beautiful things inside as well.

sents.zh: 有字，有书，也有金子做的东西。
sents.en: There is writing, there are books, and things made of gold.
Today many people come here to look.
